data.body: Operator disposition after refreshing main to origin/main commit 6fb4d801c9. F01, F06, and F07 are approved. F03 is rejected because a general prose validator would risk false-positive failures for superficial benefit. F02 will be replaced with per-package conformance limited to named files, factual claims, canonical sources, derived outputs, and explicit verification. F04 remains pending after a measured impact assessment. The assessment found 56 triggering Python blocks and 20 triggering blocks in the candidate non-Python scope, including cross-paragraph and technical-identifier false matches. The revised F04 will retain only deterministic rot-reference checks, use paragraph-local format-aware parsing, require adjudication before enforcement, and keep subjective comment quality outside automation. F05 remains approved in principle. The updated branch contains a hand-maintained generated-artifact table and duplicate test registry. Replace those lists with one typed ownership registry that mechanically renders the catalog and supplies tests and generators. Do not infer ownership by parsing source, banners, build files, or workflow text. No authored project file changed.
